t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup: a warm limestone paper sheet inset on a deep navy frame. Top-left: a small sans eyebrow and a large light-weight sans headline in sentence case. Under it, a solid navy block with mono uppercase off-white text for one note. Left 60%: a four-column table with steel-blue slash numerals in the headers, mono cells and hairline row rules only, comparing <CONTENT>. Right: an isometric technical line drawing of white polypropylene equipment and pipework, uniform hairline strokes, no shading, isolated on the sheet. Square corners.
signature_idea: A catalogue-style isometric drawing of the actual sanitization kit beside a plain comparison table, with one navy block holding the single caveat.
strengths: line drawing style matches the prompt: uniform hairlines, white equipment, no shading
sheet-on-navy-frame layout is on-brand and reusable
slash numerals in headers give the table a Swiss rhythm
navy callout is a clear, buildable note pattern
table is legible with row rules only
weaknesses: table is a plain comparison table; the drawing does not point to any row
the steel-blue side bars at the bottom edges look like leftover artefacts
pumps have heavy cast motor bodies that read as generic metal kit
invented temperatures and ratings in cells would be mistaken for facts
brand_fit_why: Limestone sheet, navy frame, steel-blue numerals, light headline and mono cells fit, but the drawing and table sit apart and the side bars are noise.
